scope: Interim diagnostic of all three completed basic-course seeds at this snapshot; not a selected-seed cohort result or new driving experiment. Seeds44/55 are not yet complete.
interpretation: Two failed trajectories enter the goal position at approximately1.44/1.50m/s,above the.25m/s parking limit. At those SAME measured pre-action states,the original actors also request positive or very weak negative acceleration. These missed-braking actions were not newly introduced wholesale by the observed PPO updates. Three other failed trajectories never enter the position tolerance;the failure is not exclusively terminal speed. This is descriptive same-state inference,not an executed initial-policy counterfactual or proof of causation. Lower-rate native continuation remains unproven.
